author: CC
prose: Orchestrator ask, 2026-11-12, census item 3: a bare subprocess argv beginning with the word bash resolves through CreateProcess to C:\WINDOWS\system32\bash.exe, the WSL launcher, not Git bash. Measured on akiendell: relay.local_executor('uname -a') reports Linux akiendell ...WSL2, cwd /mnt/c/..., and echo C:\Users\x prints C:Usersx. The root executor is sudo-based and Linux-only; the non-root executor is the one a Windows caller reaches.
